sentences.text: Welcome to Chart Plotting, the hands-on module.
On the exam you’ll work problems on a real training chart, usually NOAA chart twelve ten T R, which covers Martha’s Vineyard to Block Island.
You’ll need parallel rulers or a course plotter, a pair of dividers, sharp pencils, an eraser and, if your exam allows it, a simple calculator.
Buy the chart and tools now, bring your own to the exam, and practice with the same ones, so your hands know them by test day.
